slug: 2026-02-10 Where can refugees, foreigners register for digital ID

facts.fact: The New Times says the Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration began on 7 February 2026 an electronic ID card registration for refugees, asylum seekers, migrants and stateless persons in Kigali, with identity verification and biometric capture, running to 15 February.
facts.system: electronic identity cards for foreigners and refugees

systems.system: Electronic identity card registration for non-Rwandans
systems.owner: Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration
